report_name: Palo Alto Networks Patches 11 Flaws in PAN-OS, GlobalProtect

vulnerabilities.name: PAN-SA-2026-0011
vulnerabilities.description: An advisory addressing Chromium vulnerabilities within the Prisma Browser.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-0299
vulnerabilities.description: Multiple local privilege escalation flaws in the GlobalProtect App on Linux, macOS, and Windows versions. A local attacker could potentially gain higher-level permissions.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-0297
vulnerabilities.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability affecting mobile versions of the GlobalProtect App for iOS, Android, and Chrome OS. This could lead to denial of service or potential code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-0301
vulnerabilities.description: A low-severity information disclosure flaw in the URL Filtering component of PAN-OS, Cloud NGFW, and Prisma Access.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-0298
vulnerabilities.description: A vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks products, mentioned in the August 2026 security bulletin.

indicators.name: Palo Alto GlobalProtect Process Execution
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Palo Alto GlobalProtect Process Execution
id: 2b1f8c3a-9e4d-4f8a-a1b2-c3d4e5f6a7b8
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect client processes. This can be used for asset inventory or for hunting for exploitation attempts against vulnerable versions.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-13
level: informational
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\GlobalProtect.exe'
      - '\PanGPS.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect client processes, which can be used for asset inventory or hunting for exploitation of related vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-0299.

indicators.name: Palo Alto GlobalProtect Registry Key Presence
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Palo Alto GlobalProtect Registry Key Access
id: 9d8c7b6a-5f4e-4d3c-b2a1-f0e9d8c7b6a5
status: experimental
description: Detects access to registry keys associated with the Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect client. This can be used for asset inventory or hunting for related malicious activity.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-13
level: informational
logsource:
  category: registry_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetObject|contains: '\SOFTWARE\Palo Alto Networks\GlobalProtect'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the presence of registry keys associated with the Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect client, which can be used for asset inventory and identifying potentially vulnerable systems.

relationships.source_name: Palo Alto GlobalProtect Registry Key Presence
